conventions.H_lat: H_lat = R_lat^T W R_lat on (dx | dL), R_lat rows = [d0 row | Z row]; H_el = R_el^T W R_el on (u | eps), R_el rows = [d0 row | strain row].  Identity R_el = R_lat Phi, hence H_el = Phi^T H_lat Phi
conventions.Phi: Phi : (u, eps) -> (dx, dL) = (u + X eps, L eps).  X eps = affine displacement x_v eps of every vertex; L eps = lattice basis deformed by eps.  Domain = elasticity coordinates (u in R^128, eps in R^36), codomain = lattice-side deformation coordinates (dx in R^128, dL in R^64).  Block upper triangular for the partitions (internal | macro): [[I, X],[0, R]]
conventions.bar_vector: ell = x_v - x_u + m.L ; elongation row of u-dofs: ell at vertex v, -ell at vertex u; weight W = 1/2 on every bar
conventions.bars: 112 intra-cell bars (+-e_i to +-e_j, i<j) with m=0, then 8 bridge bars i: from +e_i in cell 0 to -e_i in cell e_i, m=e_i, ell = r_i - 2e_i = b_i (row i of B = L - 2I)
conventions.cell: 16 vertices +-e_i (vertex index 2*axis+sign, sign 0 = +); u-dofs: 8 coordinates per vertex, index vertex*8+coord (128 total)
conventions.dL_coordinates: 64 = entries (k,l) of a lattice deformation dL, index k*8+l; Z-row of a bar: m_k ell_l
conventions.elasticity: K = ae^T W ae, B = d0^T W ae, Delta = d0^T W d0 ; S = K - B^T Delta^+ B (Delta^+ : consistent solve, free variables 0) ; C = S / det L (volume normalisation)
conventions.strain_coordinates: 36 = 8 diagonal eps_kk then 28 off-diagonal eps_kl (k<l, lexicographic), eps symmetric with eps_kl=eps_lk=coordinate; strain row of a bar: (ell_k^2 | 2 ell_k ell_l)
